label: Fan-out and synthesize orchestration
description: An orchestration graph shown by SEEING it: a source node at top fans out to 2-6 worker nodes in a centered row, then converges into a synthesis node at the bottom. Thin connectors draw (scaleY) from source to workers and from workers to synth. Worker count is a parameter; the row wraps and the stagger adapts. Minimal on-screen text (short chip labels only) — the narration carries the words.
